Ghana Lease Agreement Template Pack

Complete set of legally sound lease agreements for all property types. Residential, commercial, furnished, month-to-month, and room rentals. All templates comply with Ghana's Rent Act, 1963 (Act 220) and L.I. 369.

What's Included

  • Residential Lease (12 months): Standard annual agreement with Act 220 provisions
  • Commercial Lease: For business premises with special clauses
  • Furnished Apartment Lease: Inventory and condition provisions
  • Month-to-Month Agreement: Flexible short-term rental agreement
  • Room Rental Agreement: For shared houses and single rooms
  • DOCX Format: Fully editable Word templates for customization
  • PDF Format: Professional PDF versions for printing and signing
  • Act 220 Compliance: All templates include required legal provisions
  • Excel Tracker (Agency): Track all agreements and renewal dates
  • WhatsApp Cards: 5 marketing cards (Agency tier only)
